WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_winners AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fillcount,
         p.avg_fillcount - b.benchmark AS first_margin
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_fillcount > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) AS benchmark
  FROM first_winners
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT w.avg_fillcount, w.first_margin,
         w.avg_fillcount - b.benchmark AS second_margin
  FROM first_winners w
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE w.avg_fillcount > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) AS average_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(first_margin) AS average_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(second_margin) AS average_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders;
